name: United Kingdom

format.notes: 24 questions about British traditions and customs in 45 minutes, drawn only from the official Guide for New Residents. Booked online at least three days ahead.

exemptions.age: People under 18 and people aged 65 or over do not need to take it.
exemptions.disability: People with a long-term physical or mental condition are exempt, with an exemption form or a doctor’s letter.

official_study_material.title: Life in the United Kingdom: A Guide for New Residents
official_study_material.publisher: Sold through the official Life in the UK Test shop
official_study_material.license: A book on sale (also eBook and audio); Crown copyright, not offered under an open licence on the page read

unverified.administering_agency: The page is the government booking service; the department is not named in the lines read.
unverified.format.pass_mark: Not in the lines read. Widely reported as 75%.
unverified.format.modes: Not stated in the lines read; "computer" is an assumption.

notes: The questions are not published; only the handbook and paid official practice material are.
